title: HotkeyLabelHandlerConsistency - chat caption/hotkey pairs are pairwise consistent; F313 'Q/D/N label-vs-handler discrepancy' resolved as window-id mislabeling (id 0 = 包袱 bag, NOT trade)
objective: Close the pending item from F313/EI-313 ('cap14 包袱栏(Ctrl+Q,Q) vs Q->toggle(0) trade; cap10 信息窗口(Ctrl+D,D) vs D->toggle(0xb); cap11 设置栏(Ctrl+N,N) vs N->toggle(0xc)') with primary-static evidence: prove each letter hotkey executes the same window action as its own caption click, and correct the mislabeling of window id 0 as trade (trade = id 3).
method: Fresh capstone dumps this round of (a) letter-hotkey bodies in kbd dispatch 0x42CBD0 (VK Q/D/N/G/F/B/V cases), (b) toggle dispatch jump table 0x42B3E4 + case bodies 0/0xB/0xC, (c) caption click action table 0x42C494 (16 dwords) + bodies idx 0/10/11/14, cross-referenced with window-id-catalog.json (Round 10, primary-static) for window id -> object base / frame bindings.

analysis.pairwise_consistency: Every letter hotkey in kbd dispatch 0x42CBD0 executes the SAME window action as clicking the caption that declares that hotkey: Q=包袱栏->toggle(0)=bag, D=信息窗口->toggle(0xb)=quest, N=设置栏->toggle(0xc)=settings, G=组队->toggle(6)=party, F=行会->0x4523E0 guild request, B=技能图鉴->[0x6208] flip, V=小地图->minimap open/close, C=交易栏->trade request 0x41EC10+0x451A70. No handler mismatch exists.
analysis.f313_mislabeling: F313/EI-313 pending item said 'Q->toggle(0) trade'. WRONG: window id 0 = 包袱栏/背包 (bag, F250, winmgr+0x6554, ctor 0x42EA80). Trade window = id 3 (F1050, winmgr+0x3399C, ctor 0x4159D0), which has NO caption and NO letter hotkey: it opens only via game logic (0x420486 / case 3) when a trade request is accepted. The '交易栏' caption (idx0) and letter C both send a trade REQUEST (0x41EC10 + net 0x451A70), never a toggle. Same class of mislabeling: F313 said 'G->toggle(6) guild' but id 6 = 组队 party (F900); guild = id 4 (F600), reached via the F/idx6 request path, not a toggle.
analysis.quest_caption_naming: Window id 0xB is the 任务/quest window (F700, ctor 0x4473E0). The client's own caption idx10 labels it '信息窗口'; both the caption click (0x42C1A4) and the D hotkey route to toggle(0xb). '信息窗口' is the client's chosen label for the quest window - a naming fact, not a routing mismatch.
analysis.toggle_flag_sub_offsets: Each toggle case reads flag=[winmgr+off+0x30] and sub=[winmgr+off]: bag 0x6584/0x6554, quest 0x51718/0x516E8, settings 0x51910/0x518E0 - consistent with F314's [sub+0x30] visibility-flag / vtable+0x10 show contract.

conclusions: CLOSED (primary-static, fresh dumps): chat caption/hotkey pairs are pairwise consistent; the F313 pending 'label-vs-handler discrepancy' was caused by mislabeling window id 0 as trade. Q->toggle(0) opens the 包袱 (bag), exactly matching caption 14 包袱栏(Ctrl+Q, Q).
D->toggle(0xb) opens the quest window, which the client captions 信息窗口 (caption idx10 routes to the same id). N->toggle(0xc) opens settings, matching caption 11 设置栏(Ctrl+N, N).
Trade (id 3, F1050) has no caption/hotkey of its own; 交易栏 caption idx0 and letter C both send a trade request via 0x41EC10 (not a window toggle).
G/F letters match captions 5/6: G->toggle(6)=组队 party, F->0x4523E0=行会 guild request (F313's 'G=guild' label corrected).

V letter and caption idx1 share actions (minimap open 0x451770 / close [0x6518]=0) with different cooldown gates (letter 0x64=100ms, caption 0xbb8=3000ms) - gate difference is entry-point-specific, not a mismatch.
